shellCommands.command:
/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module <<'NODE'
import fs from 'node:fs'
import vm from 'node:vm'
import { createRequire } from 'node:module'
import ts from 'typescript'
import React from 'react'
import { renderToStaticMarkup } from 'react-dom/server'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'

const require = createRequire(import.meta.url)
const source = fs.readFileSync('app/UserStats.tsx', 'utf8')
const code = ts.transpileModule(source, { compilerOptions: { jsx: ts.JsxEmit.ReactJSX, module: ts.ModuleKind.CommonJS } }).outputText
const exports = {}
vm.runInNewContext(code, { exports, require })
const UserStats = exports.default
const render = (users) => renderToStaticMarkup(React.createElement(UserStats, { users }))
const users = [
  { id: 1, name: 'John', isActive: true },
  { id: 2, name: 'Jane', isActive: false },
  { id: 3, name: 'Bob', isActive: true },
]
assert.match(render(users), /Active Users: 2/)
assert.match(render(users), /Inactive Users: 1/)
assert.match(render(users), /Active Users Percentage: 66\\.67%/)
assert.match(render([]), /Active Users: 0/)
assert.match(render([]), /Inactive Users: 0/)
assert.match(render([]), /Active Users Percentage: 0%/)
assert.match(render(users.map((user) => ({ ...user, isActive: true }))), /Active Users Percentage: 100%/)
assert.match(render(users.map((user) => ({ ...user, isActive: false }))), /Inactive Users: 3/)
console.log('UserStats render checks passed')
NODE"
